notes:
A big release: guided setup with a new scaffold agent, managed agent installs, richer diffs in the viewer, and a long list of chat and session fixes.

### New

- **Guided setup** — a new scaffold agent walks you through getting your workspace ready, with a streamlined agent step in Quickstart that just asks you to pick.
- **One-click agent installs** — enabling an agent now installs the CLI it needs for you, so nothing has to be set up by hand.
- **Review folder updates before they land** — see what an update will change to a folder and approve it before it's applied.
- **Side-by-side file diffs** — changed files now render as a clean, GitHub-style unified diff in the viewer.
- **Built-in Palette documentation** — agents can look up Palette's own docs directly, without any extra setup.
- **Shared HTML files in Organisational context** — HTML documents your organisation shares now show up alongside the rest of your context.

### Improved

- **Account checks show their progress** — agents display a clear checking state while Palette verifies your account instead of looking stuck.
- **Runtimes stay current** — Palette checks for agent updates when you launch it and when you come back to the window.
- **Only supported agent versions are used** — a CLI already on your machine is picked up only if it's new enough to work properly.
- **Polished installer** — the drag-to-Applications window now has a proper background.

### Fixed

- **Sessions no longer cross wires** — each message is routed to the tab that sent it, so replies always land in the right conversation.
- **Allow All and Plan on Gemini and Mistral** — both modes now work on these agents, and Allow All stays inside your workspace instead of reaching beyond it.
- **Permission prompts match the right request** — approvals are tied to the action that asked for them.
- **Session picker recovers from errors** — if one agent fails to list its sessions, the picker finishes loading instead of hanging.
- **Handoffs start cleanly** — a handed-off session is now seeded once its composer is ready, so nothing gets lost.
- **Reviewed changes merge correctly** — Palette merges exactly the revision you reviewed.
- **Read-only Drive folders** — publishing into a folder you can't write to now fails clearly instead of silently going wrong.
- **Codex model list** — the available models are checked against the CLI Palette is actually running.
- **Tidier composer toolbar** — the controls above the message box line up at a consistent height.
- **Working Slack invite** — the community link in Help points at a fresh invite again.
